messages:
zoe: Heads-up — new hire on M1 mac can't run `bundle install` for the ruby sampleapp, failing at native gem compile (nokogiri). anyone triaged this before?

pat: Yep. Usually missing Xcode CLT or platform mismatch. What's the error output?

zoe: `make: clang: No such file or directory` then nokogiri fails to find libxml2 headers.

mike: Typical fixes: `xcode-select --install`, `brew install libxml2 libxslt`, then `bundle config build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries --with-xml2-include=$(brew --prefix libxml2)/include/libxml2`. Also consider `gem install nokogiri -- --use-system-libraries`.

pat: For onboarding friction we should: 1) add an "Apple Silicon" troubleshooting blurb to the README, 2) add a Docker `make dev` target to avoid host deps, 3) add a lightweight CI job that runs `bundle install` on macos-latest.

zoe: Agreed. I'll open a tiny README PR with the CLT + brew snippet and the Docker one-liner. can someone add the CI smoke?

mike: I'll add the workflow in the same PR: checkout, setup-ruby, `bundle install` (no tests). Keeps it minimal.

devex-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/212 by zoe (devex/readme/apple-silicon-guidance)

zoe: thanks! this should unblock the hire. follow-up: should quickstarts prefer Docker default?

pat: Keep host steps first, but promote Docker prominently. many folks still expect native instructions.

mike: Also note bundler/platform quirks in the README: `bundle lock --add-platform x86_64-darwin` can avoid missing precompiled gems on CI.

zoe: perfect, will add that to the PR. :thumbsup:
